name: GitHub: Tier Zero PATs (All Repositories)
description: Fine-grained personal access tokens scoped to all repositories in the organization that have repository-control write permissions. A single compromised token may grant code, workflow, Actions, or administrative control across every repository. PATs with only read or lower-impact write permissions are excluded.
cypher:
MATCH (n:GH_PersonalAccessToken {repository_selection:'all'})
WHERE ANY(permission IN n.repository_permissions WHERE permission IN ['contents:write', 'administration:write', 'workflows:write', 'actions:write'])
RETURN n
